title: Arriving in Norway on a military plane and the officer's glove slap
summary: Flying to Norway with a German colonel's escort, Butler was refused entry for lack of a visa until the officer slapped the customs man; Crouch presses him to clarify who slapped whom.

This officer said, don't you see what that man has got there -- took his glove and slapped that man upside the head (whispering). I got off and -- (inaudible).
